title: Akiyama Mizuki — Rooftop Friendship〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Morning♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Morning, Mizuki...
Wait, it's past noon already!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, me turning up for classes is a special event in and of itself, no matter how late I am.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Speaking of events...
Thanks for giving me that call earlier!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm? What call?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: About the school festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have to thank you for getting me out of the house and to the festival.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But hang on. Why did you invite me to come when I didn't do anything to help with it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's a special event, so I thought it'd be a shame if you missed it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But hey, maybe you'll get to take part in the first years' festival next year if they hold you back for being absent so much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Urgh, I'd rather not be a repeater...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (An didn't want me to miss out...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At first I thought she gave me that call because it was her duty as the hall monitor or something, but she did it just out of friendship.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And she was so mindful of my situation...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Oh, and lots of students are wearing funky outfits today. A lot of the second years are in costume for their class shows too. It's really cool!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Unless you wear something really crazy, it's gonna be hard to stand out in this crowd.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We've been friends since I started high school, but I haven't really been telling her much about myself...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still, I feel comfortable around her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, guess what!
I met my friend's brother at the festival!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You mean Akito? Yeah, he told me.
I was surprised that he has an older sister.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's a second year, but only attends the night classes. I met her online and we've been making music together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow, that's cool!
Was she at the festival too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nah. Her brother said she was probably sleeping.
Ena's sleeping pattern is totally backwards.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's kind of like you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What? Hey! No, it's not!
I was awake when you called me, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess so!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, it was also news to me that you knew Rui.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
He's an old friend from middle school.
You're friends with him too?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, but I have run-ins with him while on duty...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah... I had a feeling it was something like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it was good to see him enjoying the festival.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When we were in middle school, we never participated in anything like that. We mostly just wasted time hanging out on the rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Back then, we didn't have any other friends to talk to, so we talked with each other a lot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, that's just how it was back then!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now, Rui has his own circle of friends and seems happy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, he was hanging out with Tenma, wasn't he?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I really wish he'd stopped bringing weird stuff to school.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So how have you been doing, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me? Um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm having more fun these days, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've got some friends I can talk to comfortably, like you. I made some new friends too, and I've been creating music videos.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: These new friends, are they from the same group as Akito's sister?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Bingo!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're all smiles today.
Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, you're telling me about yourself!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Usually we just talk about fashion or some random stuff, but you almost never tell me about yourself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh. It's only with you that I feel like I can be this open.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You might've developed a knack for making people comfortable talking to you after working at your dad's cafe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You think so? Oh, but you're not getting any freebies from this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Not even one cup of coffee on the house for your dear friend?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & An
rows.Line: Hahaha!
